ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixel distribution is approximately 70:30, with high-intensity pixels dominating the central lobe regions and low-intensity pixels concentrated at the perimeter and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes; low-intensity black border (approx. 5-15 pixels thick) following the entire trailing edge; irregular black pigmentation extending from the median notch down the vertical axis; sparse low-intensity speckling across the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration pattern; numerous sharp peaks and deep valleys (sawtooth morphology) along the distal halves of both lobes; extreme irregular indentation on the inner-right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edge trajectory tapering to sharp, slightly recurved distal tips; trailing edge follows an irregular, generally concave sweep towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, low-intensity circular spots distributed across the interior high-intensity field of the left lobe; concentrated dark pixel clusters near the lower peduncle junction.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of parallel, curvilinear low-intensity lines (rake marks) on the lower-right lobe; multiple unaligned thin linear disruptions on the upper-distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent traumatic indentation (tissue loss) on the proximal trailing edge of the right lobe near the median notch; extensive rake mark scarring across the ventral surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Continuous, thick black pigmentation band tracing the entirety of the trailing edge, creating a sharp high-contrast boundary against the water background.
